messages:
Selma (Partnerships): LangChain asked for a focused pilot: their orchestrator -> our gateway -> two HW partners (EdgeNode & Sigma). Need owners for adapter QA, marketplace tile, SI playbook, and joint announce. Quick owners?
Jon (Eng-Platform): I can own adapter QA and staging helm. Need a connector spec and a tiny runner image.
Luca (LangChain PM): Uploading connector spec + runner image to https://drive.example/lc/pilot. Note: supports streaming, tools, api_key by default.
Priya (Product): I'll draft the marketplace tile and SKU. Proposal: private pilot listing, request access.
Ivy (Marketing): I'll draft partner brief and a short embargoed blog once legal signs off. Recommend invite-only webinar T+12.
Jon (Eng-Platform): Compat snippet from LangChain we should test:
```
POST /v1/generate -> streaming:true, chunk:128
POST /v1/call -> supports_tools:true
compat_tag: "lc-0.37"
```
Selma (Partnerships): Owners recap: Jon (QA/deploy), Priya (marketplace), Ivy (comms), Luca (assets). I'll coordinate legal and SI outreach.
ops-bot: Preview deploy scheduled: lc-orch-mini -> staging at 2026-01-18T09:00Z (id: dep_4201).
Jon (Eng-Platform): After preview I'll run smoke matrix (endpoints, streaming, tokenization parity) and post results to https://git.internal/redwood/partnerships/lc-mini-pilot.
Priya (Product): Marketplace WIP:
```
name: "Redwood + LangChain Mini Pilot"
sku: RW-LC-MINI-PILOT-001
availability: "Invite-only"
```
Selma (Partnerships): Timeline draft:
- Assets in by EOD Tue (Luca)
- Day 2: staging deploy + smoke (Jon)
- Day 5: legal signoff
- Day 12: invite-only webinar + SI kickoff
- Day 21: public announce (if pilot succeeds)
I'll create a calendar invite and a short preflight checklist. Thanks :raised_hands:
